sourceComment: Based on EU Visa Code (Regulation EC No 810/2009). Consular rules change periodically and must always be cross-verified with the official embassy or consulate.

requirements.description: Passport must be valid at least 3 months after scheduled departure from Schengen and issued within the last 10 years.
requirements.whyRequired: Mandatory under Article 12 of the Schengen Visa Code; border authorities will deny visa issuance or entry if the 3-month buffer is violated.

requirements.description: Travel medical insurance with minimum €30,000 coverage valid across all Schengen states for the full stay duration.
requirements.whyRequired: Mandated by Article 15 of Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 to cover repatriation, emergency medical treatment, and hospital care.

requirements.description: Bank statement covering the past 3 months, issued and stamped within the last 30 days.
requirements.whyRequired: Proves genuine financial solvency and ties. Consulates reject outdated statements or those missing regular activity.

requirements.description: Name consistency across passport, flight ticket, hotel voucher, insurance, and bank statement.
requirements.whyRequired: Name mismatches cause immediate suspicion of document forgery or third-party bookings, leading to refusal.

requirements.description: Trip dates must match across flight bookings, hotel reservations, and insurance coverage.
requirements.whyRequired: Schengen visas are granted strictly for documented travel dates. Discrepancies lead to rejection.

requirements.description: Employment No Objection Certificate (NOC) issued on official letterhead within the last 30 days with approved leave dates.
requirements.whyRequired: Demonstrates root ties to country of residence and intent to return upon holiday completion.

requirements.description: Biometric photograph meeting ICAO 9303 standards (plain light background, neutral facial expression, no glare).
requirements.whyRequired: Consulates reject photos with shadows, smiling, or busy backgrounds.
If you have had a prior visa refusal, it must be openly declared on your application form to prevent SIS II fraud flags.
